currentUserGoal: Repair the visibly broken production title screen shown at a medium desktop viewport and make the result genuinely presentable.
workCompleted: Added the missing OPTIONS and CREDITS menu labels and supporting copy.
Replaced hardcoded title and menu positioning with a reusable responsive layout calculation.
Added overlap guards, edge bounds, text fitting, compact desktop composition, phone composition, and stable button spacing.
Reduced the medium-desktop title scale and moved the menu below the complete title and chapter lockup.
Fixed the selector pulse so it preserves an intentional display size instead of restoring each texture to its enormous native size.
Set selectors to a readable compact size after the initial correction made them too small.
Removed startup opacity and camera fades that could leave important title controls blank in throttled or backgrounded rendering.
Replaced large gray grass-fleck squares with 18 small colored pollen glints.
Removed the hard horizontal shade seam and replaced it with one continuous readability veil.
Added title-layout regression tests for the reported 1047x727 viewport, 1280x720 desktop, and 390x844 phone.
verificationRun: npm run check passed with ESLint, 159 Vitest tests across 21 files, strict TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
The focused title-layout suite passed all four checks.
An isolated headless Chrome capture at 1047x727 verified no title/menu overlap, all four labels, bounded selectors, and a continuous background.
The true 390x844 geometry was verified in the pure layout test; command-line Chrome imposes a 500-CSS-pixel minimum, so its cropped phone image was not treated as valid visual evidence.
Temporary QA screenshots were removed from the workspace.

release.status: Locally repaired and verified. Not merged into master or deployed by this slice.

knownIssues: The user's in-app browser remains the final subjective check for animation feel and the saved Memory Grove label at their exact browser chrome dimensions.
docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md remains an unrelated untracked file and must stay untouched unless explicitly requested.
